title: How Prunet Digital Stopped Chasing Payments and Got Its Time Back With Duplo
summary: Prunet Digital managed finances across banking apps, spreadsheets, and WhatsApp. See how Duplo helped them save time and focus on clients.
body_markdown:
Running a creative marketing agency is a constant juggling act. At any given moment, there are multiple clients with live briefs, multiple campaigns in production, multiple deadlines converging at once. The creative work is fast, energetic, and demanding in the best possible way.


The financial operations behind it are a different story entirely.


“Managing the money side of this was absolute chaos if I’m being honest,” says Nma, Operations Lead at Prunet Digital. “Expenses jump at you unexpectedly sometimes, and they are usually urgent.”


Prunet Digital is a Lagos-based creative marketing agency helping brands show up online through SEO, social media management, digital strategy, and content creation. They work with exciting brands across multiple industries simultaneously, which means their operational complexity is high, their pace is fast, and their financial processes need to keep up with both.


For a long time, they did not.

### The Problem: Financial Chaos Behind Creative Excellence


Before Duplo, Prunet Digital’s financial operations ran the way most growing Nigerian agencies run theirs: across a patchwork of banking apps, spreadsheets, WhatsApp messages, and email threads that worked well enough until they did not.


Vendor payments, subscription fees, tool costs, and transportation to shoots all needed to be managed simultaneously, often urgently, and often without a clear single point of[accountability](https://tryduplo.com/expense-management-solution-nigeria/) . Expense requests arrived through informal channels. Approvals depended on whoever was physically available to action them. And the back-and-forth between team members consuming time that should have been directed toward client work was constant.


The moment that crystallised the problem came during a client shoot. Prunet Digital needed to book a studio, which required a payment to be approved. Their finance person was not on seat. The payment could not be processed. The shoot could not proceed as planned.


“We just had to restrategize to street-style content,” Nma recalls. “It wasn’t easy, but it worked out in the end.”


It worked out. But it should not have come to that. A studio booking failing because one person was unavailable to approve a payment is not an operational edge case. It is a symptom of a financial process that is too fragile for the pace of a growing creative agency.


“The moment the business started growing, all those little inefficiencies that we had been patching together just started falling apart. That’s when we knew something had to change.”


### How Duplo Came Into the Picture


Prunet Digital’s CEO found Duplo and recommended it to the team as a way to ease their financial operations. The transition was not instant. Like any new system, it required the team to adjust to a different way of working.


“Honestly, it was a little difficult for the team to adjust to, but later on we all saw how much it made our work easier,” Nma says.


What made Duplo the right fit for a fast-paced creative agency was not any single feature. It was the feeling of a platform that understood how agencies like Prunet Digital actually operate.


“It felt like someone had actually thought about how fast-paced businesses like ours work and built a platform for us. Everything in one place. Payments, approvals, expenses, tracking, literally everything down to exporting bank statements.”


### What Changed After Duplo


**The End of WhatsApp Expense Requests**


The first and most visible change came when Prunet Digital moved expense requests away from WhatsApp messages and emails.


> “The first thing that changed when we started using Duplo was the WhatsApp messages and emails for sending expense requests.”


Today, expense requests move through Duplo’s structured approval workflow. The right person receives each request, reviews it on the platform, and approves or rejects it. Duplo also keeps a complete record of every action.


As a result, situations like the studio booking issue become easier to avoid. Instead of relying on one person’s availability to action a WhatsApp message, the approval workflow keeps the process moving within the platform.


> “We didn’t have to continuously follow up on payments any longer because of Duplo’s approval workflows. It was a breather.”


**Salary Payments in Seconds**


Before Duplo, Prunet Digital processed salaries manually through a banking app, initiating each payment individually. When the team switched to internet banking to improve the process, payment limits and token requirements created new challenges.


> “With Duplo, we simply upload a spreadsheet, and everyone gets paid instantly.”


That shift from individual payments to a single bulk upload saves the finance team significant time during regular salary runs. It also gives the agency a simpler way to manage payroll as the team grows.


**Spend Visibility Without Asking Anyone**


Nma also found Duplo’s real-time spending visibility particularly useful.


> “That’s the thing I didn’t expect to rely on as much as I do,” she says. “Just being able to see exactly where the money is, what’s being paid, what’s being spent, and what needs attention without asking anyone.”


For an operations lead[managing finances](https://tryduplo.com/blog/automate-payment-reconciliation-nigeria/) at a fast-moving creative agency, real-time spend visibility makes financial management more proactive. Instead of pulling reports or chasing team members for updates, Nma can see what the agency has spent, what remains pending, and what needs attention from one dashboard. That visibility reduces the time and effort required to stay on top of daily financial operations.


### What Duplo Gives Marketing Agencies in Nigeria


The Prunet Digital story is not unique. Creative agencies, digital marketing firms, PR consultancies, and content studios across Nigeria face the same tension: fast-moving, client-facing operations demand constant attention, yet their financial processes often cannot keep up.


These agencies manage vendor payments for production partners, tools, and equipment. They handle subscription fees for the platforms and software that power their work. They also cover transportation and logistics for shoots and activations, run salaries for growing teams, and collect and reconcile client payments. All these tasks happen at once, often through the same mix of banking apps, spreadsheets, and WhatsApp messages that Prunet Digital used before Duplo.


Duplo brings these financial workflows together on one connected platform:


**Approval workflows that replace WhatsApp.** Every expense request moves through a structured approval chain, regardless of who is available. As a result, teams can avoid delays when a finance team member cannot respond to a message.


**Bulk salary payments via spreadsheet upload.** Upload a CSV file to pay every team member at once. This approach removes the need for individual transfers and reduces the impact of banking token limits. Even as the team grows, finance teams can run payroll without multi-day payment runs.


**Real-time spend visibility.** Finance teams can see what the agency has spent, what remains pending, and what needs attention from one dashboard. Instead of asking colleagues for updates or pulling separate reports, they get a current view of the agency’s financial position.


**Expense tracking connected to reconciliation.** Duplo automatically matches each captured expense to its corresponding record and posts it to the accounting system. Consequently, month-end reconciliation becomes a quick review of what the system already recorded instead of a days-long manual exercise.

Nma’s summary of what Duplo delivered for Prunet Digital is direct:


“Duplo gave us our time back.”


For a creative agency, time is the most valuable resource. Every hour a team member spends chasing a payment approval, following up on an expense request, or manually initiating salary transfers one by one is an hour not spent on strategy, creative work, or client relationships.


The agencies that grow most efficiently are not necessarily the ones with the most creative talent or the most impressive client roster. They are the ones whose operations run cleanly enough that their creative teams can focus on what they were hired to do.


Duplo is built to make that possible.


“I would definitely recommend it to other marketing agencies out there,” says Nma.
